trap.label: discurso indireto
trap.wrong: He replied that he has run the whole way.
trap.right: He replied that he had run the whole way.
trap.why: Português mantém o tempo do original; em inglês o discurso indireto recua um tempo (have run to had run).

mcq.q: Backshift of “You will never catch me”:

fix.wrong: He said that he will come.
fix.right: He said that he would come.

fix.wrong: She replied that she runs daily.
fix.right: She replied that she ran daily.

fix.wrong: He told that he had run.
fix.right: He said that he had run.

rewrite.answer: He said that he was hungry.
She said that she would go.
He said that he had finished.
